caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a doll or mannequin centered on a plain, off-white or light beige background. The doll has dark brown hair styled in ringlets and a light-skinned face with visible pink cheeks and lips. The doll wears a light pink dress with puffed sleeves, a wide neckline edged with white lace, and a blue sash tied around the waist in a bow. The dress reaches below the knees and has a layered, ruffled texture. The doll's arms, extending straight down, appear to be jointed and are a different color, suggesting they are made of a different material, possibly wood. Beneath the dress, the doll wears white lace-trimmed bloomers that extend to mid-calf, and its feet are simple and blocky, colored light brown or beige. The background is empty, with no additional objects or features, focusing attention entirely on the centrally placed doll figure.
title: Doll--"Betsy"
